caption: The drawing depicts a vertically oriented rectangular band with a lace or mesh-like texture occupying the central portion of the composition. The lace band is white and features a pattern of botanical elements, including leaves and small flowers, arranged in a flowing, intertwined manner along the length of the band. The floral motifs have multiple narrow leaves radiating outward and small round berries or buds scattered among them. The background on either side of the lace band consists of two darker gray vertical strips, further bordered by wider light cream or off-white sections on both the left and right edges of the entire image. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the lace band running precisely down the center and equal bands of gray and cream colors on each side.
title: Embroidered Panel for Sleeve
